title: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.26869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magne

translated_title: LatticeMind：一个用于密度泛函理论工作流的验证门控智能体框架
translated_abstract: 第一性原理计算很少是单一求解器调用：它们是多阶段工作流，其中结构、设置和保存的密度必须在相互依赖的阶段之间正确传递。语言模型可以写出有效的单一输入文件，但一旦阶段被串联起来，可靠性就会崩溃：遗漏的依赖关系、错误的文件交接或幻觉产生的关键字即使求解器正常运行也可能使结果无效，而这类错误只有在代价高昂的计算执行之后才会显现。我们提出了LatticeMind，一个验证门控的智能体框架，它将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的密度泛函理论（DFT）项目。工作流契约规定了所需的阶段、文件和依赖关系；确定性验证器在任何求解器启动之前对项目进行检查；失败的检查会触发有界修复；并且报告保持可追溯到项目文件。在一个涵盖总能量、态密度、能带结构、磁性……等性质的44个案例RESCU基准测试中……（摘要截断）
tldr: LatticeMind是一个验证门控的智能体框架，通过工作流契约、确定性验证器和有界修复机制，将自然语言请求转换为可执行且可检查的密度泛函理论（DFT）项目，解决了语言模型在串联多阶段第一性原理计算工作流时的可靠性问题。
en_tdlr: LatticeMind is a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable DFT projects via workflow contracts, deterministic validators, and bounded repair, addressing reliability failures of language models when chaining multi-stage first-principles calculation workflows.
